description.value: Garrison Wine & Liquor Merchants is a neighbourhood liquor store in the Garrison Crossing shopping area of Chilliwack, BC, with a curated selection of wines, spirits, and local BC producers from the Okanagan Valley and Fraser Valley. The store regularly hosts in-store tastings featuring regional and international labels. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack could stop here to pick up locally made BC wines and spirits.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 65m; wave at 67m; wave at 86m.
